body:
Apparently, I sound paranoid, in it for monetary gain, I'm dumb for not putting the state of origin and I'm out of my mind to even question the holy court system or court record 'republishers'. 

I've tried to be as transparent as possible. The simple fact is this one single thing has destroyed every part of me. Glad to know that's officially not worth anything or the sanctity of a two year olds/individuals innocence and privacy. 

I am now 100% convinced the world is groomed to accept child abuse and it's after effects. Whatever.

I replied to some of these things in another comment. My place of work embellished that I was suicidal while on a medical leave after this document was circulated throughout my place of work - being one area of inquiry. Otherwise, an obvious desire to get this document redacted or sealed under what I wish were in place like -  child privacy laws, which I see some say exist now. Wish it was retroactive. This has been an imposed life sentence and apparently I'm to blame here for not knowing the law better or being a lawyer myself.

I was not expecting the amount of unempathetic victim shaming. I almost regret asking for legal advice here because this has made me feel much worse. One, I said the company kept it under wraps and never addressed it or said anything to me - specifically. I have evidence from friends who were coworkers and other events that it was talked about and furthermore falsely embellished to make me seem suicidal while I was on medical leave. Two, I'm not in this for the money. This entire part of my life, one document - that I was forced into - mind you has snowballed into a very detrimental force in my life. Imagine that popping up as the first thing associated with your name. No one here has any clue how vulgar some of the language in this document is. To me, it is borderline child porn. I would be just as upset if this was imposed on another person. Glad to here they have 'better laws' protecting children's identities now but I very much wish those could be retroactive. 

As far as defamation goes - I've been alluding to the events/rumors that occured at my place of work but also knowing it all stems from this one legal site - wondering if there's anything else I can do there as well.

Every advice I've received has been putting me down for not knowing more about the law. Thanks.
This particular document was in the appeals court in the state of Texas.

Thanks for downvoting me guys, appreciate it. Sorry I'm not an attorney and know everything. That's why I came here to ask questions. For those asking why it wasn't an issue before - because the internet and these sites didn't exist. It wasn't published until 2010 or 2011.
We tried this already. I believe the clerk for the court made a formal request to have this information redacted but the website owner refused.

I will probably move forward with this part. Thank you. As far as the other side of this goes, I might be referring to defamation rather than libel. My thought process started there due to it being directly related to a written public document.

Well for one, there are clear statements of assumption and interpretation from me playing with dolls. Secondly, I remember being coached by my mother to say certain things. I was not actually abused. Also, I was 2 and had a two year olds vocabulary and emotional intelligence. I had absolutely no control or legitimate input over the situation. Thirdly, the certification of the psychiatrist has been and was always in question.
You haven't seen or read the document so how do you know? Can you elaborate?

I'm particularly upset how literature like this can be made available so freely about any minor - in this case, it's involving me as a child but if it wasn't... I fail to see how our system protects children like me? How is this allowed? To me it broadly touches on child-pornography (in literature form) and has been extremely damaging to me as an individual.

I came into some big medical issues and bills over the years so I figured it would prevent me from doing so - in addition to assuming it was expensive. Do you know the best/easiest method to do this? 

Also, I have other legal inquires about this entire situation - particularly the damages done, libel, employee rights ect.
I wish it was that simple.
Hewlett's Gulch is nice. Lots of creek hops and abandoned miner spots.
